fy.title: GW Undergraduate Admissions — First Year Applicants

test_policy.notes: Test-optional for most applicants (since 2015). SAT/ACT still required for B.A./B.S.-M.D. applicants, homeschooled applicants, and applicants from schools that give only narrative evaluations. Superscores SAT and ACT. Choose test-optional before submitting; changes allowed only within 2 weeks of submission.

requirements.notes: One letter of recommendation required, from a counselor or an academic teacher. Optional writing supplement. Evaluative interviews are not required or offered; an optional InitialView video interview does not replace the English requirement. BFA applicants (except Interior Architecture) need a portfolio.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I (binding)
deadlines.notes: Notification late December. The page lists month and day only (Nov. 1); year inferred for the fall 2027 cycle.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II (binding)
deadlines.notes: Notification late February. The page lists month and day only (Jan. 5); year inferred for the fall 2027 cycle.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Notification late March. The page lists month and day only (Jan. 5); year inferred for the fall 2027 cycle.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived if the SAT EBRW is 650+ or ACT English is 29+, or if the applicant will have completed the most recent 4 years of secondary education at a school where English is the primary language of instruction. Requests are due by the application deadline. EAP in the first year may be required based on results; EAP waived with TOEFL 100 (old) / 5 (new), IELTS 7.5 or Duolingo 130.

aid.notes: International students are not eligible for need-based financial assistance but are eligible for merit scholarships with no additional application; any merit award is noted in the admission letter.
